summary: Your battery is draining about three times faster than typical, mostly while the screen is off. Background activity keeping the device awake is the most likely cause.

findings.title: Background activity keeps the phone awake
findings.explanation: The device stayed awake for about three hours without the screen being used. This usually comes from apps syncing or holding wake locks in the background.

findings.title: Long screen-on time
findings.explanation: Almost seven hours of screen time in a day accounts for part of the drain.
